summary: Investigated pi-discover's 11 model-facing tools, the harness registration/dispatch path, the keyless DuckDuckGo/Bing web layer, the PDFium worker pipeline and its on-disk caches, image/figure handling, swallowed failure modes, and every hard-coded limit. No build/test commands were run (read-only). Findings keyed to file:line below.
architecture: index.ts registers the Pi extension; src/extension.mjs registers /discover and the input hook. src/controller.mjs builds the isolated SDK agent session, creates the tools via createResearchTools (tools.mjs) and passes them to sdk.createAgentSession({tools, customTools}); the SDK owns the tool-calling loop, and controller subscribes to session events. tools.mjs implements all 11 tools plus the SSRF-guarded HTTP/DNS-pinned fetch layer (no third-party web package). PDFs are imported as vault attachments and parsed by @hyzyla/pdfium inside a worker thread (pdf.mjs/pdf-worker.mjs), with page text/PNG/metadata cached under Sources/pdf-<sha>/ in the vault.

files.description: All 11 model tools, JSON schemas, web search/fetch, attachment reads, source records, save_visual; tool wrapper and result() shape.
readPdf: validation, on-disk cache lookup/write, worker orchestration, page budget, image content blocks.
PDFiumLibrary text extraction + PNG page rendering with size/pixel caps.
createResearchTools wiring into sdk.createAgentSession, prompt/image attachment flow, Deep review correction pass.
REVIEW_TOOLS (7-tool reviewer subset) and REVIEW_LIMITS budget constants.

report:
# pi-discover tools & document/PDF ingestion — investigation report

## 1. Tool table (all defined in `src/tools.mjs`, factory `createResearchTools` at tools.mjs:370)

Schema builders: `object(properties, required=[])` → `{type:'object',properties,required,additionalProperties:false}` (tools.mjs:17); `string(description, maxLength=20000)` (tools.mjs:18). Return builder `result(data, text=JSON.stringify(data,null,2))` → `{ content:[{type:'text',text}], details:data }` (tools.mjs:19). Image-returning tools append `{type:'image', data:<base64>, mimeType}` blocks. Each `tool(...)` wraps execute as `async (_id, params, signal, _onUpdate, _ctx) => { if (signal?.aborted) throw abortError(signal); return execute(params, signal); }` (tools.mjs:371-374).

| # | name literal | parameters (name: type [constraints], required?) | returns (details) | gating |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `recall_conversation` (tools.mjs:379) | `query` string maxLen 300; `entryId` string 128; `offset` integer min 0; `maxChars` integer 1–20000; `limit` integer 1–12 — all optional | `{scope, matches:[{entryId,timestamp,role[,toolName,failed],provenance,text,offset,totalChars,truncated[,nextOffset][,imageCount,imageNotice]}], totalMatches, notice}` (context.mjs:60-75) | Requires `options.getConversationEntries`; else throws (tools.mjs:380) |
| 2 | `research_workflow` (tools.mjs:383) | `name` enum [`compare`,`critique`,`figures`] required | `{name, instructions}` | Always; invalid name throws (tools.mjs:384) |
| 3 | `read_note` (tools.mjs:387) | `path` string 512 required; `maxChars` integer 1–20000; `offset` integer min 0 | `{path,text,revision,offset,truncated,totalChars[,nextOffset]}` (vault.mjs:423-425 or readSavedText tools.mjs:325-328) | Always |
| 4 | `search_notes` (tools.mjs:395) | `query` string 300 required; `limit` integer 1–20 (default 8) | `{warning, matches:[{path,title,snippet,revision,score}]}` (vault.mjs:446) | Always |
| 5 | `read_attachment` (tools.mjs:396) | `path` string 512 required | text block + `{type:'image',data,mimeType}`; `details:{path,mimeType,bytes}` (tools.mjs:296) | PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP only, ≤8 MiB, must exist; SVG/PDF/OCR rejected |
| 6 | `read_pdf` (tools.mjs:397) | `path` string 512 required; `startPage` integer 1–2000; `pageCount` integer 1–8; `includeImages` boolean; `maxChars` integer 1–20000 | text JSON `details:{warning,sourceId,path,title,totalPages,pages[],cached}` (+`page-XXXX.png` image blocks when includeImages) (pdf.mjs:113-120) | `includeImages` gated by `options.canReadImages()` (pdf.mjs:47); text pageCount caps 8, image pageCount caps 2 (pdf.mjs:45) |
| 7 | `web_search` (tools.mjs:398) | `query` string 500 required; `limit` integer 1–10 (default 5) | `{warning,verification,provider,fallbacks,retrievedAt,results:[{title,url,snippet}]}` (tools.mjs:401) | Always |

PDF: delegates to `readPdf` after `vault.importAttachment` (tools.mjs:407-409) | `allowPdf:true` for this call only (tools.mjs:406) |
| 9 | `save_knowledge` (tools.mjs:419) | `title` string 200 required; `text` string 100000 required; `sources` array maxItems 32 of string 96; `expectedRevision` string 128 | `{path,revision,previousRevision,presentation}` (vault.mjs:509+; tools.mjs:428) | Always; needs-fix formatting throws (tools.mjs:427) |
| 10 | `check_presentation` (tools.mjs:430) | `markdown` string 100000 required | `{status:'passed'|'needs-fix'|'unverified', digest, checked, issues[], message?}` (presentation.mjs:9-32) | Always |
| 11 | `save_visual` (tools.mjs:431) | `spec` object (chartSchema) required; `sourceIds` array maxItems 32 of string 96 | manifest `{schemaVersion,visualId,title,conversationId,sourceIds,illustrative,createdAt,specPath,path,markdown,presentation}` (tools.mjs:357-366) | Always |

`chartSchema` (tools.mjs:376): object requiring `['type','title','xLabel','yLabel','series']`; `type` enum [`line`,`bar`,`scatter`]; `title` string 160; `xLabel`/`yLabel` string 120; `series` array minItems 1 maxItems 8 of `{name string 80, points array minItems 1 maxItems 1000 of point}` (required `['name','points']`); `point` = `object({x: anyOf[number,string maxLength 80], y: number}, ['x','y'])` (tools.mjs:375); `sources` array maxItems 12 of `{title string 200, url string 2048}`; `caption` string 1000.

Mode availability: the lead agent receives **all 11 tools in both Ask and Deep** — same list, only the system prompt changes (controller.mjs:174-180; test asserts `request.tools.length === 11` and identical across modes, tests/runtime.test.mjs:275-276). Inside Deep, the bounded reviewer session is filtered to the 7 retrieval tools `REVIEW_TOOLS = ['web_search','fetch_source','read_pdf','read_attachment','read_note','search_notes','recall_conversation']` (review.mjs:10; filtering at review.mjs:133-140).

## 2. Registration and dispatch

- Extension entry: `index.ts` default export `discover(pi)` → `registerDiscover(pi, { loadSdk: () => import('@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent') })`.
- Harness surface is only the command + input hook: `pi.registerCommand('discover', command)` (extension.mjs:164); `pi.on('input', ...)` (extension.mjs:165) routes non-empty turns into `controller.prompt(...)`; `pi.on('session_start'|'session_shutdown', close)` (extension.mjs:186-187). No `pi.registerTool` is used.
- Tools are registered with the **SDK**, not `pi`: `const customTools = createResearchTools(this.vault, { getConversationId, getConversationEntries, canReadImages: () => this.session?.model?.input?.includes('image') === true, presentationTimeoutMs })` (controller.mjs:174), then `await this.sdk.createAgentSession({ cwd, agentDir, modelRuntime, model?, thinkingLevel?, settingsManager, resourceLoader, sessionManager, tools: customTools.map(tool => tool.name), customTools })` (controller.mjs:175-180). Reviewer: `sdk.createAgentSession({ ..., tools: REVIEW_TOOLS, customTools: tools })` (review.mjs:139-140).
- Dispatch loop lives in the SDK; this repo only wraps execute (tools.mjs:371-374) and observes events: `this.session.subscribe(event => { if (event.type === 'tool_execution_start') this.onStatus('Researching · ' + event.toolName); ... })` (controller.mjs:182-201). `boundRequests` monkey-patches `session.agent.streamFunction` to cap reviewer requests (review.mjs:85-102).

## 3. Web search / fetch implementation

- **No `pi-web-access` package and no env var.** package.json dependencies are only `@hyzyla/pdfium@2.1.13` and `pngjs@7.0.0`. The only env vars in the repo are `PI_RESEARCH_CONFIG_DIR`, `PI_SCHOLAR_STATE_ROOT`, `PI_SCHOLAR_OBSIDIAN_ROOT` (config.mjs:7,24-25), test vars `PI_RESEARCH_SDK`/`PI_RESEARCH_AI`, and browser-harness vars — none supply web access.
- Keyless providers, tried in order, first non-empty wins (tools.mjs:250-267): `DuckDuckGo Lite` `https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q=<enc>`, `DuckDuckGo HTML` `https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=<enc>`, `Bing RSS` `https://www.bing.com/search?format=rss&q=<enc>`. Each failure is appended to `fallbacks:[{provider,error}]`; all failing throws `Web search returned no parseable results... No results were fabricated.` (tools.mjs:267).
- Parsers: `searchResults` matches anchors whose class contains `result__a`/`result-link`, unwraps `uddg` redirect param, skips `*.duckduckgo.com`, snippet from `result__snippet`/`result-snippet` (tools.mjs:202-222). `rssResults` refuses `<!DOCTYPE`/`<!ENTITY` (tools.mjs:227) and requires `<rss>` (tools.mjs:228).
- Result item shape: `{ title, url, snippet }` with title ≤300 and snippet ≤1200 chars (tools.mjs:215-217, 237-240). Top-level search result adds `warning`, `verification`, `provider`, `fallbacks`, `retrievedAt` (tools.mjs:401).
- Fetch layer: `retrieve` (tools.mjs:144-180) — SSRF guard `parsePublicUrl` (tools.mjs:55-67, blocks localhost/private/reserved + non-80/443 ports + credentials), DNS-resolve-and-validate `validateTarget` (tools.mjs:87-96), DNS-pinned `pinnedFetch` via `node:http`/`node:https` with `user-agent: 'Discover/0.6.0 (+local research tool)'`, `accept: text/html,text/plain,application/json;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1`, `accept-encoding: identity` (tools.mjs:98-115). Redirects manual, max 4 (tools.mjs:153). Content-type allowlist: `application/pdf` (only when `allowPdf`), `text/*`, `application/json|xml|xhtml+xml|rss+xml` (tools.mjs:167-170). No response cache — every call re-fetches; only `fetch_source` persists the body to the vault. Returns `{url, body, mimeType, retrievedAt}` (tools.mjs:174).

## 4. PDF path

- Library: `@hyzyla/pdfium` `PDFiumLibrary` (pdf-worker.mjs:2) plus `pngjs` `PNG` (pdf-worker.mjs:3); pinned `VERSION = 'pdfium-2.1.13-v1'` (pdf.mjs:6). Parsing runs in a `Worker` thread (pdf.mjs:15) with `resourceLimits { maxOldGenerationSizeMb: 128, maxYoungGenerationSizeMb: 32 }` (pdf.mjs:17); default timeout `timeoutMs = 20000` (pdf.mjs:12).
- Page-count limits: worker rejects <1 or >2000 (pdf-worker.mjs:10); metadata validity requires totalPages 1–2000 (pdf.mjs:67); `startPage` 1–2000 (pdf.mjs:45). PDF file size ≤50 MiB `MAX_PDF` (pdf.mjs:7,55). Must start with `%PDF-` (pdf.mjs:61) and live at `Attachments/<id>.pdf` (pdf.mjs:44).
- Text extraction: `page.getText()` normalized, per-page slice to 24000 chars with `truncated` flag (pdf-worker.mjs:15-16); tool `maxChars` budget default 12000 (pdf.mjs:43) applied across pages (pdf.mjs:114-116). No OCR.
- Images: only with `includeImages`; render `scale = Math.min(2, 1600 / Math.max(width,height))`, reject >2,560,000 px, PNG colorType 6, reject >8 MiB (pdf-worker.mjs:19-25); page dimensions ≤100000 (pdf-worker.mjs:19).
- Cache on disk (inside the linked vault): page key `sourceId = 'pdf-' + sha256[:48]` (pdf.mjs:62); per page `Sources/pdf-<sha>/page-XXXX.json` (record: version, sha256, number, text, textHash, truncated, image{width,height,sha256}), `page-XXXX.md` (title + `[[<pdf path>#page=N|…]]` link + text + truncation note), `page-XXXX.png`; `Sources/pdf-<sha>/Source.md`; `Sources/pdf-<sha>/metadata.json` (pdf.mjs:97-112). Original bytes cached by `vault.importAttachment` at `Attachments/<sha256[:48]>.pdf` with `Attachments/<id>.json` metadata (vault.mjs:458-492). Cache reuse validates version/sha256/textHash and PNG sha256 (pdf.mjs:63-80); `cached()` treats >200000-byte files, ENOENT, bad JSON as cache misses (pdf.mjs:34-39). `details.cached = missing.length === 0` (pdf.mjs:120).

## 5. Image / figure handling

- Reaching the model: images are delivered as content blocks `{type:'image', data:<base64>, mimeType}`. `read_attachment` returns one (tools.mjs:296); `read_pdf` with `includeImages` interleaves text + image blocks per page (pdf.mjs:117-118); the controller pushes staged/pasted images into `session.prompt(..., { images: attachedImages })` (controller.mjs:~286-296). Vision model required: controller throws `The selected model does not accept images` (controller.mjs:~298), `read_pdf` throws if `canReadImages() === false` (pdf.mjs:47).
- Into the vault: every pasted/attached image is persisted by `vault.importAttachment` to `Attachments/<sha256[:48]>-<ext>.<ext>` (+ `.json` meta), deduped by hash (vault.mjs:458-492). Message projection embeds images as Obsidian `![[<path>]]` (vault.mjs:119-125 `attachmentMarkdown`); the model sees a text pointer `Saved image N: [[path]] (Use read_attachment...)` instead of path clutter (controller.mjs:~299-302).
- Figures from PDFs: rendered page PNGs are stored at `Sources/pdf-<sha>/page-XXXX.png` and returned to the model as image blocks; the generated page note links to the original PDF page (`[[<pdf>#page=N|…]]`) but does **not** embed the PNG. Charts save `Visuals/<uuid>/preview.svg`, embedded as `![[Visuals/<uuid>/preview.svg]]` in `Visual.md` (tools.mjs:347-358). No automatic OCR, no figure extraction into notes, no figure cropping.

## 6. Failure modes: handled vs silently swallowed

Silently swallowed (return empty/null/continue):
- tools.mjs:121 `discard()` `catch { /* Best effort */ }`; tools.mjs:119 `body.cancel().catch(() => {})`.
- tools.mjs:77 `withAbort` consumes an already-rejected promise (`void Promise.resolve(promise).catch(() => {})`).
- tools.mjs:219 `searchResults` per-anchor `catch { /* Discard malformed/non-public result links */ }`; tools.mjs:243 `rssResults` per-item `catch { /* Ignore malformed/non-public result items */ }`.
- tools.mjs:262-265 `searchWeb` swallows each provider error into `fallbacks` and proceeds (only throws after all fail).
- pdf.mjs:38 `cached()` returns `null` on ENOENT/`ERR_RESEARCH_JSON`/`SyntaxError` (otherwise rethrows); pdf.mjs:80 ENOENT on missing page PNG sets `valid=false`.
- tools.mjs:333/336 controller `unlink(temp).catch(() => {})` and `saveStream(...).catch(() => {})`.
- vault.mjs:47 `serialized` swallows the previous op's rejection before chaining; vault.mjs:116 `noteTitle` `catch {}` on JSON.parse.
- controller.mjs:~309 `try { voice = readText('Style/Voice.md') } catch (error) { if (!isMissing(error)) throw error; }` (missing voice silently OK); controller.mjs:277 origin.json missing is tolerated; controller.mjs `session_before_compact` catch warns and returns undefined (native compaction fallback).
- presentation.mjs polling loop swallows `ENOENT`/`ERR_RESEARCH_JSON`/`SyntaxError` (12-13) and cleans up with an ENOENT-swallowing unlink (32).
- extension.mjs `reopen` ignores non-ENOENT? No — rethrows non-ENOENT; ENOENT treated as no pointer.

Clearly surfaced errors (throw to model/user): SSRF/URL rejections, unsupported MIME, HTTP non-2xx, oversized bodies, redirect overflow, PDF validation/worker errors, integrity hash mismatches, presentation `needs-fix`, knowledge revision conflicts (`ERR_RESEARCH_CONFLICT`), model-failure `last.message.stopReason === 'error'`, review budget/context exhaustion (`stoppedStream`, review.mjs:79-102).

## 7. Hard-coded limits / timeouts / truncation

- tools.mjs:15 `MAX_BYTES = 2*1024*1024` (2 MiB text retrieval/read).
- tools.mjs:150 request timeout `min(max(requestTimeoutMs ?? 15000,10),30000)`; tools.mjs:153 max 4 redirects; tools.mjs:56 URL length 4096.
- tools.mjs:173 PDF remote body cap `20*1024*1024` (20 MiB) vs 2 MiB otherwise.
- tools.mjs:285 `read_attachment` max `8*1024*1024`.
- tools.mjs:320 `readSavedText` 2 MiB limit; vault.mjs readNote/search 2 MiB per-file limits (vault.mjs:405,438); search scans first 128000 chars (vault.mjs:437).
- tools.mjs:271 sourceIds max 32; tools.mjs:215-217/237-240 title 300 / snippet 1200.
- Defaults: read_note maxChars 12000 (tools.mjs:388); web_search limit 5 (tools.mjs:400); search_notes limit 8 (tools.mjs:395); fetch_source maxChars 12000 (tools.mjs:405,416); read_pdf maxChars 12000 / pageCount 3 (1 with images) (pdf.mjs:43).
- pdf.mjs:7 `MAX_PDF 50 MiB`; pdf.mjs:12 timeout 20000 ms; pdf.mjs:36 cache file ≤200000 bytes; pdf.mjs:45 pageCount caps 8 text / 2 image; pdf.mjs:47 vision gate.
- pdf-worker.mjs:10 page count 1–2000; :16 text 24000 chars/page; :19 dimension ≤100000; :20 scale `min(2,1600/max)`; :22 pixel cap 2,560,000; :25 PNG cap 8 MiB.
- presentation.mjs default `timeoutMs = 8000`, poll `delay(100)`, result file ≤50000 bytes, ≤30 issues, message ≤1000 (presentation.mjs:5,9-32).
- review.mjs:11 `REVIEW_LIMITS = {requests:4, tools:6, outputTokens:16000, requestTokens:8000, timeoutMs:180000, packetChars:64000, images:4, imageBytes:12*1024*1024}`; reviewLimitsForModel scales down for small windows (review.mjs:106-110); `shouldReview` thresholds 1800 chars / 500 chars with retrieval (review.mjs:13-17).
- context.mjs: compaction `reserveTokens`/`keepRecentTokens` cap 16384/20000 (context.mjs:23-24); recall defaults maxChars 6000 / limit 6 (context.mjs:58); conversationBrief chunks 2200 / summary 4000 / maxChars 12000 (context.mjs:95-98).
- controller.mjs: stream flicker timer `setTimeout(..., 180)`; compaction retry `maxRetries: 2`; reference note read 24000 chars (`continueNote`, `contextNote`).
